description: DX_DFIR Zeek stream: @timestamp = the record's ts (Filebeat's read time moves to event.ingested), event.dataset = the Zeek log name (from the file name), event.provider = zeek, network.bytes for conn. Native fields are left untouched.

script.description: event.dataset from the log file name
script.source: def p = ctx.log?.file?.path; if (p instanceof String) { int i = p.lastIndexOf('/'); String base = i >= 0 ? p.substring(i + 1) : p; int d = base.lastIndexOf('.'); String name = d > 0 ? base.substring(0, d) : base; if (name == 'zeek' && base.endsWith('.jsonl')) { name = 'zeek_index'; } if (ctx.event == null) { ctx.event = new HashMap(); } if (ctx.event.dataset == null) { ctx.event.dataset = name; } }

long b = 0; if (ctx.orig_ip_bytes != null) { b += ((Number) ctx.orig_ip_bytes).longValue(); } if (ctx.resp_ip_bytes != null) { b += ((Number) ctx.resp_ip_bytes).longValue(); } if (ctx.network == null) { ctx.network = new HashMap(); } if (ctx.network.bytes == null) { ctx.network.bytes = b; }
